messages.text: I need to order one catering box for tomorrow morning for pickup. What options do you have?
We have a catering box for $48.00, which contains wheat, milk, egg, and tree nuts. We can fulfill this order if tomorrow falls within our opening hours.
Please confirm the specific date for the pickup tomorrow morning. What is the earliest time I can collect the catering box?
Could you please specify the date for tomorrow? Once I have the date, I can confirm our opening hours and the earliest time you can pick up the catering box.
Tomorrow is Tuesday. Please confirm the absolute earliest time I can collect the catering box.
The absolute earliest time you can collect the catering box tomorrow, Tuesday, is 07:00. We are open from 07:00 to 18:00.
